findings.repair: Change the guard to a 'three-problem deck (01_glm52_fused_moe, 02_deepseek_nsa, 03_megaqwen_decode)' so it matches the current protocol and still guards against silent task-set reuse.

uncertainties: I cannot recompute per-row canonical sha256 (69efa028... / owner-facing hashes) or re-run transport/qualification checks; owner-verified capture hashes and receipt are taken as given, the absence of my execution being a limitation, not missing evidence.
